data.description: MAG Park at Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR), Dubai, is an exclusive residential enclave developed by MAG Property Development.

data.answer:
MAG Park by MAG Property Development is a premium townhouse community within MAG City in Meydan District 7, MBR City. As of 2025, the project features ready and near-ready homes that blend modern design with a tranquil, family-friendly atmosphere.

The community offers a curated collection of 4- and 5-bedroom smart townhouses, ranging from 5,354 to 8,650 sq ft., each designed with private yards, rooftop terraces, swimming pools, and maids’ rooms. MAG Park offers residents an exceptional balance of privacy, comfort, and urban convenience, surrounded by landscaped greenery and pedestrian-friendly spaces.

Real estate in MAG Park consists of luxurious triplex townhouses thoughtfully designed for comfort, technology, and style. Each unit includes spacious ensuite bedrooms, walk-in closets, show kitchens, and outdoor entertainment terraces with private pools.

With an emphasis on innovative, sustainable design, MAG Park attracts end-users and investors seeking a modern lifestyle in a growing district. Thanks to its premium design, location, and developer reputation, MAG Park offers an estimated 5 – 7% ROI and continues seeing rising demand for resale and rental opportunities across MBR City.

Buying a Property in MAG Park, Dubai

Investing in MAG Park Dubai offers multiple advantages, such as its premium location within the MAG City master community, developed by one of Dubai’s most reputable developers.

The project offered a 40/60 payment plan with installments over two years during its pre-handover phase. Now, in 2025, most homes are ready for handover and occupancy.
Buyers benefit from 100% freehold ownership, and purchases above AED 2 million qualify for the 10-year Golden Visa.

Given its modern architecture, excellent amenities, and connectivity, MAG Park represents one of the top-performing townhouse developments in MBR City.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in MAG City Development?

data.answer:
Life in MAG Park blends the peace of suburban living with the energy of Dubai’s urban core. The community features a 980 sq.m. central park, wellness areas, cycling and jogging tracks, and community retail spaces within the wider MAG City master plan.

The environment is secure, green, and ideal for families who value privacy, outdoor recreation, and modern comforts.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in MAG Park

MAG Park is directly connected via Al Meydan Road and Al Khail Road (E44), allowing residents to reach Downtown Dubai in just 10 minutes.
Nearby metro stations include Business Bay Metro Station in Business Bay, and Onpassive Metro Station (formerly Al Safa), accessible in 15–20 minutes.

Each townhouse comes with two private covered parking spaces, and street parking is available for visitors. The community also includes bicycle-friendly routes promoting a healthy, sustainable lifestyle.

Supermarkets in and near MAG Park

Several supermarkets are conveniently located near the MAG Park community. Residents can easily reach:

  • Lulu Express, Al Quoz – 9 minutes
  • Carrefour, Meydan – 12 minutes
  • Spinneys, Polo Residences – 10 minutes

The upcoming Meydan One Mall, one of Dubai’s most significant retail hubs, will offer shopping, dining, and entertainment just a few minutes away.

Shopping Mall in and around MAG Park, Dubai

MAG Park’s prime location provides easy access to some of Dubai’s top shopping destinations. The Dubai Mall, just 15 minutes away, offers an exceptional mix of luxury boutiques, dining experiences, and world-class entertainment. Within the community, residents can also enjoy retail outlets and boutique stores in the MAG City development, ensuring everyday convenience. Additionally, the upcoming MAG City Retail Boulevard will feature cafés, grocery shops, and lifestyle brands all within walking distance from home.

Schools and Nurseries in and near MAG Park

MAG Park is surrounded by some of Dubai’s most reputable schools and nurseries, making it an excellent choice for families. Within a 10–15-minute drive, parents can access top institutions such as GEMS World Academy, North London Collegiate School, Hartland International School, and Kent College Dubai. These schools offer British and IB curricula, ensuring high-quality education options for children of all ages. The proximity to these educational hubs means families can enjoy a convenient, well-connected lifestyle without long daily commutes.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near MAG Park

MAG Park residents have access to several mosques within Meydan, while The Gatekeepers Church (Al Quoz) and The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (Al Safa) are about 12 minutes away.
Additionally, Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurdwara and Hindu Temple Dubai can be reached in 25 minutes.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near MAG Park

Well-known healthcare facilities, including Emirates Hospital Dubai and American Hospital Dubai, are just a 15-minute drive from the MAG Park community. Additional options nearby include Aster Hospital and Mediclinic Welcare Hospital.

Location & Nearby Areas

MAG Park’s prime location within District 7 of MBR City ensures quick access to key areas in Dubai. Al Khail Road (E44) is conveniently located just 9 minutes from the community, providing seamless connectivity to other parts of Dubai. Nearby areas such as Al Quoz and Sobha Hartland Dubai are also within easy reach, just a 13-minute drive away.

more_info.question: Things to Do in MAG City Development

data.answer:
The community provides an active lifestyle with outdoor activities such as jogging, cycling, and swimming. With a horse racing track nearby and multiple parks, residents can engage in sports and recreational activities year-round. 

Nearby attractions include Meydan Racecourse, The Track Golf Course, and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, ideal for recreation and family outings.

Restaurants

Residents of MAG Park can explore a variety of dining options, from casual eateries to fine dining restaurants located within the wider MBR City development. Some of the most popular eateries worth visiting are Bab Al Mansour, Al Hamidieh Restaurant, and Leila Restaurant.

Beaches near MAG Park Community

Jumeirah Beach is just a 19-minute drive away, offering residents easy access to Dubai’s pristine coastline. The beach provides opportunities for relaxation and water sports, enhancing the outdoor lifestyle of those living in MAG Park. 

Hotels in and around MAG Park

Several luxury hotels are located near MAG Park, offering additional amenities and dining options for residents and visitors. You can easily access City Avenue Hotel and Citymax Hotel Business Bay.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

MAG Park facilities and amenities include a 980 sq.m. central park, complemented by children's play areas, jogging and cycling tracks. Residents also get to enjoy outdoor sports facilities, a horse racing track, and swimming pools with cabanas.

Community Events

MAG Park Dubai fosters a sense of community by hosting regular events and activities for residents. These gatherings create opportunities for social interaction and strengthen the neighborhood’s community spirit.

Attractions and Landmarks

The community’s proximity to major landmarks such as the Dubai Mall and Safa Park ensures that residents have access to some of the best attractions in the city. MAG Park's nearby attractions make it easy for residents to enjoy the vibrant culture of Dubai.

MAG Park offers a luxurious lifestyle with high-end amenities. For those seeking luxury living in MAG Park Dubai with excellent connectivity and world-class facilities, the investment is well worth it.

About MAG Park at MBR City

MAG Park at Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR), Dubai, is an exclusive residential enclave developed by MAG Property Development. Nestled within MAG City in Meydan District 7, this community redefines modern family living with its collection of luxurious 4- and 5-bedroom townhouses, each designed with contemporary architecture and smart home features.

Strategically located near Al Khail Road (E44) and Al Meydan Road, MAG Park ensures effortless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport. The serene yet central setting makes it ideal for residents seeking both convenience and tranquility.

Residents enjoy many world-class amenities, including lush parks, swimming pools, retail outlets, dedicated fitness and wellness zones, and family leisure areas, creating a vibrant, community-oriented lifestyle in the city's heart.
